data.name: Najeebat
data.long_meaning: One who is guided, aided or helped, derived from the Arabic root N-J-B which means to guide or help. This name is often given to a girl who is expected to be a source of guidance and assistance to those around her.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who is believed to have a strong spiritual connection and is capable of guiding and helping others on their spiritual journey.

in_pashto.name: نجیباټ
in_pashto.meaning: د لوړ نسبه، ښه سیرت، او عزتمند

data.cultural_impact: The name Najeebat is of Arabic origin and is rooted in Islamic culture. In Arabic, the root letters N-J-B mean "to guide, to help or to be guided." As a result, the name is often given to girls who are expected to be pillars of strength and guidance to their families, friends and community. In various Islamic societies, the naming of a child is considered an important aspect of Muslim culture and reflects their religious and cultural beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Najeebat holds spiritual significance in Islam as it reflects the idea of guidance and assistance from Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Allah loves to be invoked and He loves to answer the invoker so long as he does not invoke Him for an evil purpose." (Bukhari). Thus, the name Najeebat suggests a deep spiritual connection with Allah, and the expectation that the bearer of this name will be guided and helped by Him throughout her life. Moreover, the name also signifies the importance of helping others and being a source of guidance and assistance to those in need, which is a fundamental Islamic principle.
